description: This file defines a logging utility class 'Log' for handling different levels of log messages, including info, warning, error, and documentation issues, with support for colorized output based on OS.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A logging utility class for managing and displaying log messages with different severity levels and optional color formatting.

methods.name: __Print
methods.description: Internal method to print text, optionally with a file prefix.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Logs an informational message if show_infos is enabled.

methods.name: DocIssue
methods.description: Logs a documentation issue message if show_doc_issues is enabled.

methods.name: Warn
methods.description: Logs a warning message if show_warnings is enabled.

methods.name: WarnLine
methods.description: Logs a warning message associated with a specific line in a file, with optional context from an object.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Outputs a message directly, with optional file context.

methods.name: Dump
methods.description: Outputs all accumulated errors, warnings, and info messages.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Sets the current file context and logs a processing message.

methods.name: Ellipsis
methods.description: Shortens a text string to 32 characters, adding ellipsis at front or back.
